tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Along with the submission of each of the President’s annual budget requests to Congress, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report which—

children.text: identifies the amount of Department of Energy funds that were, as of the end of the previous fiscal year—
specifically describes the purposes for which all such funds are intended; and
explains the effect that information contained in the report has had on the annual budget request for the Department of Energy being simultaneously submitted.

tree.heading: Definitions
tree.text: Within 90 days after October 24, 1992, the Secretary shall submit a report to the Congress containing definitions of the terms “uncosted obligation”, “committed uncosted obligation”, and “uncommitted uncosted obligation” for purposes of reports to be submitted under subsection (a).
